ruler.rule_lineage: r1 regex -> r2 regex -> r3 regex -> r4 AST per-file -> r5 module graph -> r6 scope+prose/structure -> r7 attribute slot (Q71) + attributed-fold exoneration (Q67=1 / Q75) -> r7b a cell identity that does not move when the file's lines move -> r7b1 a fold anchor recognised through a spread, but only beside a provenance label -> r7b4 ORD-0408 ruling A: a *_code cell is exonerated only by the closed set that the contract in the scanned tree names for that field, never by the field name; a contract declaring no enum for the field is a named red (CONTRACT_MISSING_ENUM) and the cell is not handed to the fold either -> r8 ORD-0536: every exemption is looked up in a frozen, in-code table keyed by (rule x sink-shape family x origin_kind) plus one measured evidence predicate; every cell is reported before exemption, so an exemption changes a cell's verdict and never the denominator, and the table's schema is incapable of naming a file, a line or a cell id - which is what "not by the commander's hand" means in an instrument
ruler.order: ORD-0536 (structured exemption, this revision) on top of ORD-0408 (r7b4) + ORD-0354 (attribute slot + line-independent cell identity) + ORD-0348 (fold exoneration) + the r7b spread-anchor follow-up filed 2026-09-28 03:2x

ruler.naming: local file name == published generation name from r7 onward

scope: module-graph: relative imports, index files, re-exports and namespace imports resolved (--tree)
scope_note: this mode is the one the pre-landing gate must run: it can both clear a value a helper rebuilds from device wording and condemn a value that arrives through an import
method: whole-graph module resolution: relative specifiers, .ts/.tsx and index files, `export ... from`, `export * from`, default and namespace imports. An import binding is answered by the exporting file's own data flow, so a helper that returns the answer's words reaches the cell in the file that prints it. Package specifiers are recorded unresolved, never guessed at.
standing_rule: Q64=1 (arbiter): data reaching UI / screenshot / evidence artifacts must pass source classification -> allowed fields -> render. mask is a helper, never the first gate.
forbidden: the answer's own words reaching the DOM by any route, including across a file boundary
truncated_meaning: how many lookups ran out of depth and had to answer unknown - a clean verdict with a nonzero value is not a proven clean verdict
